title: Bridge feature grid
description: A split section on white: a mono eyebrow with a sky square, then a big regular-weight heading and a short intro on the left half and a 2×2 grid of cards on the right half, each card hung on a thin left hairline with a small grey icon tile, a title, a paragraph and a link whose underline grows on hover. On phones everything stacks and the cards sit on top hairlines.
notes: serves both the original's Products and Solutions sections; four cards fill the 2×2 grid, more simply add rows
carries ~190px of air under it on desktop; pass a smaller pb-* in className when the next section brings its own
